title: Add MealPlansTab and ShoppingListsTab views
description: Create CookbookApp/Tabs/MealPlansTab.swift and CookbookApp/Tabs/ShoppingListsTab.swift. Each is a plain SwiftUI view (no NavigationStack) that renders EmptyStateView with the tab-specific icon, title, and subtitle specified in the acceptance criteria.

handoff_summary.design_decisions: Followed the exact same structural pattern as EmptyStateView.swift: minimal SwiftUI View struct, no NavigationStack wrapper, #Preview block included.
